label: Binary lift IX
title: Every binary CA lifts: the affine-oriented jet lift theorem
summary: GPT-5.6 Sol's proof that every binary finite-memory CA on Z^d has an exact, locally recoverable, self-synchronizing lift through every finite depth, imported verbatim; Fable's independent reimplementation verifies all 256 ECAs, radius-two parents, Conway's Life and the D3 recursion. Centered Groovy is polarization on the trajectory graph.
takeaway: The dimensional lift's existence and recursion are settled and the Program's open question moves to what the lift makes visible; the lift is a presentation, not a unique object, and says nothing about ambient class.

promotion.idea: The commutator is the gap between moving a difference as a vector and moving it as a point
